title: 2026 TCS New York City Marathon — The Course
claims: The 2026 TCS New York City Marathon course runs 26.2 miles through the five boroughs of NYC.

The 2026 course makes minor adjustments in the Bronx: after the Willis Avenue Bridge, runners turn left onto East 135th Street, right onto Alexander Avenue, continue straight, turn left onto East 141st Street instead of East 138th Street, turn left onto Third Avenue, right onto East 138th Street and cross the Madison Avenue Bridge.
The 2026 edition is the first course change in 15 years and marks the 50th anniversary of the five-borough course, first run on 24 October 1976.
Purified water is available at official fluid stations every mile from mile 3 to mile 25, except miles 5, 7 and 9.
Gatorade Endurance Formula Lemon-Lime is available at the same official fluid stations every mile from mile 3 to mile 25, except miles 5, 7 and 9.
In warmer weather, misting stations are available at every fluid station.
Fluids are dispensed in compostable cups, with tables on both sides of the course.
Culligan filtered self-serve water refill stations are available in each borough at miles 8, 14, 17, 20 and 23.
Maurten Gels are available at Gel Depots at miles 12 and 18, with limited and non-guaranteed supplies; the organiser advises carrying your own fuel and taking one gel per depot.
Bananas are available at mile 21.
Portable toilets, including wheelchair-accessible ones, are located at every mile beginning at mile 3.
Dedicated lactation spaces are provided at miles 8, 17 and 22.
Medical aid stations are located approximately every mile starting at mile 3 and at the finish, with AEDs in start and course medical tents, ambulances and post-finish medical tents.
The medical emergency number is 866-705-6626 and the Medical Information Hotline for friends and family is 855-697-7786.
Mile markers are posted every mile and kilometre signs every 5 kilometres; all course clocks are set to wave 1.
Timing systems are located at the start, every mile beginning at 3M, every 5K beginning at 5K, halfway (13.1M), 25.2M and the finish.
The course schedule is designed to allow participants maintaining a 16-minute-per-mile pace, based on the wave 5 start, to complete the course on the streets.
Sweep buses follow the marathon route at approximately a 16-minute-per-mile pace based on the final wave start and carry runners who drop out to the post-finish area.

Runners who finish through 22:00 ET receive a finisher medal, an official result at results.nyrr.org, 9+1 credit toward the 2027 race and an Abbott World Marathon Majors star; those finishing after 22:00 ET receive a medal but are not recorded as official finishers and receive no official result.
Participants who have not completed the course must not go through the finish line or they will be disqualified and barred from future TCS New York City Marathons.
To claim a checked bag, runners enter Central Park West at 62nd Street; after 19:00 unclaimed bags move to the NYRR RUNCENTER and are available on Marathon Monday, 2 November, from 09:00 to 20:00.
On race day, 1 November 2026, the NYPD closes streets along the course, and unsanctioned bicycles or unauthorised activities are not allowed on the closed course.
